label: FICTIONAL profile mechanics fixtures; not complete requests or sector policies

cases.title: Loan repayment reversal
cases.source: A customer-facing repayment reversal is requested. UI, flow, stored state, interfaces and production-risk analysis are in scope. The reversal commitment point is undecided.
cases.first_question: At which event is the reversal final, and who owns partial recovery?

cases.title: Digital-channel campaign enrollment
cases.source: App and web enrollment changes include UI, flow, data, contracts and production risks. Repeat enrollment while the first result is pending is undecided.
cases.first_question: What happens on repeated enrollment while the first outcome is unknown?

cases.title: Backend partner status adapter
cases.source: This is backend-only; no human-facing design is changed. Flow, data, interfaces and production risk are in scope. The partner's late-result guarantee is not supplied.
cases.first_question: Which supplied interface version defines late completion and retries?

cases.title: Corrected settlement report
cases.source: Generate a backend report through an existing consumer interface; no screen is changed. Flow, data semantics, contracts and risk analysis are included. Event-time versus correction-time attribution is undecided.
cases.first_question: Does a correction alter the original reporting period or the correction period?

cases.title: Delegated operator action
cases.source: Change an operator screen, permission flow, stored delegation and action contract. Production-risk analysis is included. Revocation during a pending action is undecided.
cases.first_question: What happens when delegation is revoked after preview but before execution?

cases.title: Exact static copy replacement
cases.source: Replace the static label Settings with Preferences in the supplied English copy resource only. Layout, navigation, interactions, flow, data, API, contracts and risk-bearing behavior are unchanged and excluded. No other locale changes.

cases.title: Identifier meaning migration
cases.source: Migrate a stored identifier and its backend consumer contracts; no UI is changed. Include flow, data, interface and operational risk analysis. Old-client coexistence and partial-backfill recovery remain undecided.
cases.first_question: What identity mapping and coexistence rule apply before backfill completes?
